content.summary: W1 is a planned P0 parallel Hermes WorkLead handoff for the real Academy selection24 objective; only orchestration scaffolding is prepared, with no detailed execution or native dispatch established.
content.wholeObjective: Use detailed research-type question analyses to inspect real Academy-labelled grade-3 multiplication, division and circle questions, compare mathematical similarity using Jev-1.14, and select 24 questions whose easiest source difficulty is 중, with 상 and 최상 also available.

proposedWorkLead.runtimeOwner: Native Hermes, with research/domain semantics retained by the existing owners.

expectedOutputs: Source-pinned evidence map for grade3 multiplication38, division36 and circle31 detailed types, distinguishing the 46 upper-grade connections from this grade3 scope.

An explicit unresolved-meaning list including the HC11-d1-T02 unapplied correction warning, source revisions and scope coverage.
currentUnknowns: Exact source difficulty code-to-label mapping for 중/상/최상.
Current supported configured MCP verified-execution boundary.
Actual inspected mathematical question content and exact chosen source edition/unit coverage.
Unit-by-difficulty quotas and tie-break criteria for the24 selection; historical9/9/6 unit allocation remains a proposal.

sourceAndPrivateCustody.gitAllowed: Typed coordination, reviewed source contracts and minimized metadata/hashes only.
sourceAndPrivateCustody.privateOwnerRetained: Real question/source payloads, publisher images, student records, credentials, sessions and native stores remain with their existing private owners.
sourceAndPrivateCustody.modelInput: Actual question content requires an explicitly qualified owner input path and minimized authorized data before any Jev call.
sourceAndPrivateCustody.historicalEffects: Existing parent/month-end/native histories are preserved outside this new empty effect inventory; empty means no effects of this new Work, not absence of historical effects.

content.currentExecutionLimit: The present user request is priority/identity/WorkLead preparation. Detailed execution is handed to the WorkLead later; this record is not a native command or permission grant.
content.acceptance: Source validation and planned handoff only; no actual Jev usage, real question reads, complete mathematical audit, final question selection or user acceptance is claimed.

jevHandoff.catalogObservation: Parent orchestrator reports current catalog text/image support; this scaffold makes no provider or model call.
jevHandoff.nativeAdapterLimit: Existing native harness adapter is text-only Noul/Choice and uses an old unrelated ODI ledger. Qualify a current Work-bound supported caller before detailed execution; never reuse that old admission/ledger.
jevHandoff.dispatchLimit: Prepare an idle WorkLead pane only; no initial model prompt or stale native pre_llm admission is established by this source scaffold.

resourcePolicy.priority: Preserve headroom for other user work and minimize academy memory pressure.
resourcePolicy.retainedFrontend: Frontend runtime is off and held by current user instruction. Start only on a later explicit frontend review/resume request.
resourcePolicy.idleWorkers: Keep unneeded WorkLead panes at shell prompts; terminate owned completed worker runtimes after durable results.
beforeEachLaunch: Observe current host MemAvailable, memory PSI and own active processes.
Assess headroom for the next concrete workload; a past observation or free swap is not launch approval.
Defer the new workload when available headroom is insufficient or memory pressure is rising.
workloads: Start WorkLeads sequentially instead of simultaneous native/MCP initialization.
Serialize browser/build/test/indexing and model-input preparation batches; keep question/image batches bounded.
Reuse existing source dependencies and previews instead of duplicating servers/browsers or broad indexes.
pressureResponse: Checkpoint and retire only owned optional idle workers after exact process verification.
Reconcile uncertain operations before any later new launch; do not blindly retry.
preserved: Unrelated user jobs/services/data remain under their own owners.
No swap, cgroup, global model/configuration/permissions or system service changes through this policy.
resourcePolicy.implementation: Source-owned WorkLead instructions and manual orchestration checks; no monitoring daemon, scheduler or alternate runtime.

frontendHold.restartCondition: Only a later explicit user request to review or resume frontend work. Resource recovery, dependency completion, handoff or another WorkLead starting does not release this hold.
